WITH cutover AS (
  SELECT t.id AS task_id, t.label AS task_label
  FROM tasks t
  WHERE t.id = 'task:order-platform-legacy-cutover'
),
production_deployment AS (
  SELECT ttd.object_id AS deployment_id
  FROM task_targets_deployment ttd
  JOIN cutover c ON c.task_id = ttd.subject_id
),
production_services AS (
  SELECT s.id AS service_id, s.label AS service_label
  FROM services s
  JOIN service_deployed_to_deployment sd ON sd.subject_id = s.id
  JOIN production_deployment pd ON pd.deployment_id = sd.object_id
),
api_service AS (
  SELECT ps.service_id, ps.service_label
  FROM production_services ps
  JOIN test_verifies_service tvs ON tvs.object_id = ps.service_id
  JOIN tests t ON t.id = tvs.subject_id
  WHERE t.label LIKE '%API%'
)
SELECT scb.object_id AS boundary_id, b.label AS boundary_label, a.service_id, a.service_label
FROM api_service a
JOIN service_crosses_boundary scb ON scb.subject_id = a.service_id
JOIN boundarys b ON b.id = scb.object_id
